images.filename: How to Create a User Feedback Loop

The right side presents four purple rounded boxes connected by arrows: "Collecting Feedback," "Analyzing Feedback," "Implementing Changes," and "Closing the Loop," with a dashed arrow returning to the first step. The design uses a light background, dark purple typography, and flat vector-style illustrations in a clear, balanced layout.
images.caption: Infographic explaining an iterative user feedback loop through four stages: collecting, analyzing, implementing changes, and closing the loop.
images.title: How to Create a User Feedback Loop
